name: Airbus A380
headline: length
subtitle: A380-800, the largest passenger airliner
description: The Airbus A380 is a double-deck, four-engine airliner and the largest passenger aircraft built. Airbus's airport planning document gives an overall length of 72.73 m, a wingspan of 79.75 m and a tail height of about 24.1 to 24.3 m. Depending on the weight variant, its maximum takeoff weight is up to 575 tonnes.

measures.label: Tail height
measures.note: Ground to top of the vertical tail, varying with weight and centre of gravity

measures.label: Maximum takeoff weight
measures.note: Heaviest weight variant (WV011); other variants are lighter

sources.title: A380 Aircraft Characteristics: Airport and Maintenance Planning (revision of December 2025)

caveats: Heights depend on the aircraft's weight and balance; the range covers the loading cases in Airbus's table.
